findings.description: enable_key_rotation is not set, so it defaults to false and the CMK's key material is never automatically rotated. Long-lived key material protecting the logs bucket increases the blast radius of a key compromise and breaches common key-management baselines.

No explicit key policy is supplied, so AWS applies the default policy granting the account root full control of the key, meaning any IAM principal in the account that can be granted kms:* may use, administer, or schedule deletion of the key protecting log data. An explicit key policy scoping usage and administration to named principals should be defined.

deletion_window_in_days is set to the minimum of 7 days, shortening the window in which an accidental or malicious scheduled key deletion can be detected and cancelled. Destroying this CMK would render the encrypted logs permanently unreadable, so a longer window (e.g. 30 days) is preferable for a key protecting audit data.
